purpose: Phase-6C population state machine (legal transitions + irreversibility) and the deterministic population-response dynamics defaults. All values are SCHEMATIC tuning knobs for a normalized virtual population - never biological rates, cell counts, or doubling times. Recovery is legal ONLY before apoptosis_dominant; committed apoptotic cells are never resurrected.

state_machine.recovery_policy: Backward (recovery) edges exist only among the recoverable states and only reclassify SURVIVING cells; they never lower the apoptotic fraction. No transition out of apoptosis_dominant / stable_terminal_state.

defaults.susceptible_ceiling_note: A resistant living sub-population never becomes apoptotic (schematic heterogeneity); apoptotic_fraction is capped at this ceiling.
defaults.pre_commitment_leak_note: Small sub-threshold accumulation representing the most-susceptible tail of the population before the modal (single) cell commits.
defaults.adaptive_stress_window_note: Sustained-but-survivable schematic stress drives adaptation of living cells; above the window cells trend to apoptosis, below it there is little to adapt to.
